goal: Replace editor and assignment allowlists with manage_roles and complete binary protected-role semantics.
acceptance: manage_roles can create, edit, and assign ordinary roles but cannot change itself or a held role.
Protected-before or protected-after role operations are active-superuser-only.

PROTECTED_CAPABILITIES covers every currently critical effective capability, including waiting-list and memory review access; false, none, empty, unknown, and malformed values follow the documented effective/fail-closed semantics.
Only active superuser can change explicit protected metadata.
Role creation rejects reserved or invalid codes and collisions with existing technical, AD, or memory groups; Group and GroupProfile materialization is idempotent.
Role deletion is not exposed or implemented.
is_staff grants no product authority and administration allowlists are inert before their reviewed expected-hash runtime migration.
A dedicated active-superuser management command removes only the legacy administration block under the common lock and audit.
